clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall, a dusty letter sheds light on Stalvan Mistmantle’s past in Moonbrook. The unsent parchment was found in an old footlocker and confirms that he lived there before his disappearance.

Investigators searching for Stalvan Mistmantle’s past find an unsent letter in an old footlocker in Moonbrook. Darkshire’s town registry still gives his last address as the Moonbrook Schoolhouse, and Clerk Daltry wants to know whether he truly lived there. The letter confirms that Stalvan resided in the Westfall township for a time. Finding it disturbs a vengeful Forlorn Spirit, which guards the remnants of Stalvan’s past with bitter malice.
